development: existing 32 scx development targets; same frozen candidates and A layouts

arms.E: D donor fixed; bounded XY placement competes with its isotropic placement
arms.F: same candidate pool; bounded XY and isotropic placements compete with unchanged safety gates

selection: choose F cap with lowest character-mean geometry among caps with terminal angle no worse than D and equal or higher activation; require geometry strictly better than D, otherwise choose 1.0; ties prefer smaller cap
confirmation: user_001 independent data batch, character-grouped split before profile building; physical author identity not assumed; parameters frozen on scx only
repeats: all captures of a character stay together; score each capture then mean within character before across-character summary
training: only train-group raw records build A and retained-source profile; eval targets never enter profile construction
fallbacks: retain complete D placements when anisotropic options fail; report actual axis-ratio activations separately
raw_capture_policy: all source vertices, pressure and relative within-stroke timing retained; globally retime in output stroke order
default: experimental runner only; no production switch change
matching: 8 bounded rematching iterations; accept only decreasing transformed-frame equal-arclength anchor SSE; cap 1 returns frozen isotropic fit exactly
